headlines.title: Seagate Is Still Up 86% in a Year. UBS Says That’s Enough
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysUBS cut its Seagate price target to $520 from $750 and kept a Neutral rating, which leaves 10% upside. In October, UBS said it expects industry hard drive supply to speed up as Western Digital completes its move to HAMR drives.

headlines.title: Seagate Technology Got Hammered By Multiple Compression, Falling 40% in 3 Months: This Renowned Wall Street Desk Targets 185% Gains Following Earnings
headlines.summary: Seagate's revenue jumped 61% last quarter, yet its stock shed nearly half its value in three months. Locked-in contracts, a cheap forward multiple, and a rival's HAMR push leave one question: is this a bargain or a cyclical trap?

headlines.title: Why Is Seagate (STX) Down 32.3% Since Last Earnings Report?
headlines.summary: Seagate (STX) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

headlines.title: 122% Upside for Seagate? Citi Thinks So, and Here’s How
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysCiti reiterated its Buy rating and $1,050 target on Seagate after the latest drop, 122% above a Nov. 25 close that sits 57% below the June closing high.

headlines.title: Seagate (STX) Stock Fair Value Edges Lower As Analysts Rework AI Storage Assumptions
headlines.summary: The latest analyst work on Seagate Technology Holdings reflects a modest reset in expectations, with the fair value estimate trimmed from US$1,044.83 to US$1,022.75. This shift lines up with a split analyst narrative, where some reports are tempering targets as they reconsider how durable hard disk drive economics and AI storage demand might be. As you read on, you will see what is driving this evolving story and how to keep track of the moving pieces around Seagate.

description: Seagate Technology Holdings plc engages in providing data storage solutions in Singapore, the United States, the Netherlands, and internationally. The company offers External and internal hard drives; external and internal solid-state drives (SSDs); enterprise hard drives and SSDs; data storage systems; network attached storage (NAS) hard drives; video and analytics hard drives; and hyperscale and cloud solution. It offers its products for Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Surveillance & Security, and telecommunication industry. The company sells its products primarily to original equipment manufacturers, distributors, and retailers. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Singapore.
